name: harry-potter-pack
label: Harry Potter Personality Pack
description: The Harry Potter cast as agent voices - 160 named characters plus a Shakespearean insult-and-curse voice - with a gallery of original avatars. Install it and the voices appear in Settings > Personalities and in the Chat personality dropdown; this page is the gallery and a shortcut for choosing one.
author: magicalmutation-coder

steps: Install the pack from the App Store. Its first sync merges the voices into Settings > Personalities and copies the avatars into the avatar picker; no restart is needed.
Settings > Personalities edits the prompt. The Chat bar's personality dropdown picks one for the next run. A Use button on this page makes that character the default for new runs.
The pack is plain JSON in personality-packs\. Add an entry with a lowercase slug, a label and a prompt, raise version, and the next boot merges only the names that are still missing.
fixes: Save Settings once (or reload this page) so the app's syncFunction runs. If the app is switched off in Settings > Features, switch it on first - a disabled app does not sync.
A character I deleted came back

It should not. The pack marker in jobs\personality-packs.json records id@version, so a deletion sticks until the pack's version is raised. If it does come back, the marker was deleted; delete the entry again or edit its prompt to something you want.
